_comment: Tag-KV run v2: NO LoRA — frozen backbone (v3 full_step_30000), ONLY the TagCodeEmbedder (76M) trains, LR 2e-5 (1/5th of the collapsed run's 1e-4 — the 28-block gradient sum plus Lion scale-free sign updates homogenized all tags to one vector by ckpt1000: tag-tag cos 0.487 init -> 1.0000; see worklog 2026-10-01). lora_rank 0 gates inject_lora off in the trainer. Trackio monitoring (HF, local storage): loss + pre-clip grad norms (total / bit_embed / mlp / norm scales) every step, preview grid at eval steps; view with .venv/bin/python -m trackio.show k2-tags-tc. Same data/seed/cadence as the collapsed run (trainer_samples_v3 5 sources, tag_column tags, per-tag 10% dropout, uncond 0.1, 256px batch 8/GPU, preview+save every 1000). RESTART at ckpt 6000: num_workers 2->8 / prefetch 2->8 (loader was the bottleneck: 186/5849 steps stalled >6s every ~25 steps, ~30% wall time; wrapper is clean, executor.map joins per step by design). offset 0->6000 so the plan continues where the stopped run left off (plan is deterministic in seed; worker count does not consume plan RNG — only per-row tag-shuffle order re-rolls, augmentation noise). RESTART-2 at ckpt 7000: instrumented fb_fn/main-loop phase timings (t_cond/t_vae/t_prep/t_fwd/t_bwd + gap/step_total/trackio) logged to trackio to localize the periodic ~60s GPU-idle stalls (workers idle, loader exonerated, dashboard exonerated, main process spikes to 270% CPU at stall onset).
